note: Design point of the planted effect (levels 6 and 7). Recomputed by packages/validators/test/system/design.test.ts and calibration.test.ts, clustered.interval.below and above are upper bounds of the tail masses of the interval under the law of the mean of 225 clustered campaigns: a lattice convolution of the enumerated law at step 1e-4, values rounded down for the lower tail and up for the upper tail.

exactLaw.note: the design effect estimated on one clustered campaign, over all 10626 histograms of spec pass counts

interval.note: Cornish-Fisher interval of the mean over 225 campaigns at alpha, each tail at most alpha / 2
